note: Diagonal observation-error table for the observation cost J_o (woof.grad.obs_cost). One row per (platform, kind). error is the standard deviation in the kind's unit; relative_error (refractivity only) is a fraction of the observed value, linear in height between the listed nodes and constant outside them. gross_sigma rejects a pair on the reference trajectory when |H(x) - y| > gross_sigma * error; the accepted set is then frozen for every perturbed run, so J stays a smooth function of the control. max_elevation_diff_m drops a surface report whose station elevation differs from its column's model terrain by more than that. The values are UNCALIBRATED defaults of the order of NCEP's conventional error table (prepobs_errtable, the source woof/data/da/conventional-obs-types.v1.json also cites) and of the usual GNSS-RO refractivity error profile (about 2 % at the surface falling to 0.2 % by 12 km); replace them with --error-table FILE for any scientific use.
